description: This Java class 'ConceptSetsEditor' extends PropertyEditorSupport and provides functionality to convert a string of concept IDs into a list of ConceptSet objects, filtering, adding, and updating concept sets accordingly.

classes.name: ConceptSetsEditor
classes.description: A property editor for converting a space-separated string of concept IDs into a list of ConceptSet objects, managing additions, deletions, and normalization of weights.

methods.name: ConceptSetsEditor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the editor with a collection of existing ConceptSet objects.

methods.name: setAsText
methods.description: Parses a space-separated string of concept IDs, updates the internal collection of ConceptSets by adding new ones, removing missing ones, and normalizing weights.
